comment: Variation of whatis-inventory-keeps-map-over-three-line-status: a longer pack puts the inventory menu's (end) footer on row 22, so docorner() clears the suffixes of rows 21 to 23 and reprints the corridor at map row ROWNO-1, column 76, past the end of status line 1. bot() repaints status line 1 after the data-base window without clearing to the end of the row, so that corridor stays beside the status text.
